note_id.description: The note holding the action item's source line.

item_id.description: The action item's id, as list_outstanding_items, get_note, or list_commitments report it.

done.description: True to tick the checkbox and close the tracked commitment; false to untick it and reopen.

NoteId.description: Stable note identifier, e.g. "n_a1b2c3". Generated at creation, never rewritten on move/re-route. This is the write handle.
